سررنا (form I)
# سَرَرْنَا (sararnā) /sa.rar.naː/: first-person plural past active of سَرَّ (sarra)
# سُرِرْنَا (surirnā) /su.rir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of سَرَّ (sarra) and سُرَّ (surra)
# سَرِرْنَا (sarirnā) /sa.rir.naː/: first-person plural past active of سَرَّ (sarra)
